text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:"cat > /app/output/gen.py <<'PY'
"""Generate the fixed butter-on-raisin trajectory from the frozen RoboLab state."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
from rcb_robolab import Session


def generate():
    out = Path('/app/output')
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    s = Session('butter_above_raisin', instance='/app/instance.json')
    p = s.primitives()
    s.record_start()
    p['hold'](30)

    # The mesh origins are offset; grasp the geometric centre across its narrow side.
    butter_centre = s.object_bounds('butter').mean(axis=0)
    yaw = p['yaw_for_closing_dir']([-0.16, 0.987])
    quat = p['top_down_quat'](yaw)
    p['move_ee']([butter_centre[0], butter_centre[1], 0.14], quat,
                 speed=0.14, settle=5)
    p['move_ee']([butter_centre[0], butter_centre[1], 0.007], quat,
                 speed=0.045, tol=0.002, settle=5)
    p['close_gripper'](25)
    p['move_ee']([butter_centre[0], butter_centre[1], 0.16], quat,
                 speed=0.06, settle=15)

    # Account for the small offset of the box within the grasp.
    butter_bounds = s.object_bounds('butter')
    raisin_bounds = s.object_bounds('raisin_box')
    ee_pos, _ = s.ee_pose()
    place_xy = raisin_bounds.mean(axis=0)[:2] - (
        butter_bounds.mean(axis=0)[:2] - ee_pos[:2])
    p['move_ee']([*place_xy, 0.16], quat, speed=0.065, settle=10)
    p['move_ee']([*place_xy, 0.067], quat,
                 speed=0.035, tol=0.003, settle=10)
    p['open_gripper'](20)
    p['move_ee']([*place_xy, 0.18], quat, speed=0.07, settle=20)
    p['hold'](40)

    actions = s.record_stop()
    status = s.status()
    s.save_trajectory(actions, out / 'trajectory.npz')
    (out / 'generation_status.json').write_text(json.dumps(status, indent=2) + '\n')
    print(json.dumps({'n_actions': len(actions), **status}), flush=True)
    s.close()
    if not status['success']:
        raise RuntimeError('The generated trajectory did not satisfy the task.')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    generate()
PY
